mods.name: SkyblockRemaining
mods.description: A client-side Skyblock utility mod providing quality-of-life HUD overlays for Hypixel Skyblock.

releases.notes:
# 🚀 Release Notes v0.1.0-beta

## 🎯 Features

### Mod Config UI
- Custom dark-themed config screen accessible via `/sbr` or Mod Menu
  - About page displaying mod version and description
  - General page with HUD settings

### Coordinate HUD
- Displays current X, Y, Z coordinates on screen
- Toggle visibility on/off from the General config page
- Drag to reposition via the HUD editor screen

## ⚙️ Config & Commands
- `/sbr` command opens the config screen
- Settings persisted to `config/SkyblockRemaining/general.json`

## 📝 Documentation
- Added README
- Added JavaDoc across all classes and methods

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/RemainingDelta/Skyblock-Remaining-1.21/commits/v0.1.0-beta
